Title: Harvest rider request and quote UI patterns
Problem / Request: Refine the phone experience around the existing QR quote, request confirmation, and rider status pages without creating a second form, writer, or lifecycle.
Acceptance Criteria: Locked From/To/Pickup time/Pulse fare/Request/Confirm sequence; one-thumb accessible UI; truthful loading/error states; existing downstream behavior unchanged; only license-cleared reuse.
Integration Hooks: Only verified permissive source may be copied; other sources remain reference-only.

builder.usage: No AI used during the Builder run — PULSE-061 source and validation are embedded in Builder v0.6.0.
